threads.name: Wren's return and adjustment
threads.description: Wren Halloway returns to Greymouth to take over the chandlery and begins to familiarize herself with the place. | Wren continues to adjust to her new role, meeting Ada and starting to understand the chandlery's operations. | Wren investigates discrepancies in the ledger with Edric Thorne, indicating ongoing challenges in her adjustment.

threads.name: Community preparation for the storm
threads.description: Wren and the town's people prepare for a fierce storm by securing the boats in the harbor under Thorne's direction. | The women gather inside the warehouse for safety as the storm rages outside.

threads.name: Duty and accountability
threads.description: Wren visits the customs office to address her aunt's unpaid duties and negotiates a solution with Officer Crane.

threads.name: Mysteries of coastal wrecks
threads.description: Wren attends a supper club at Liesel Marr's bakery where they discuss various wrecks along the coast, including the _Crescent Moon_ and the _Morning Star_.

threads.name: The missing ledger and journals
threads.description: Wren finds missing entries in her aunt's ledger and discovers a journal with references to 'Ethan'. | Wren and Ada find a hidden tin box containing additional ledgers and journals in the marsh. | Wren discovers a hidden ledger in the altar cloth at the harbour chapel.

threads.name: Wren's market activities
threads.description: Wren sets up her stall at the Greymouth market early in the morning, selling lamp oil and rope. | Wren continues her market activities by interacting with local vendors and customers.

threads.name: The Marisol mystery
threads.description: Wren begins investigating the disappearance of the Marisol, a small coastal schooner that vanished eleven years ago.

threads.name: Thorne's recovery
threads.description: Thorne recovers from his illness and Wren continues to record his progress in the ledger. | Thorne recovers fully and emerges from his room, looking healthier.

threads.name: Search for the Marisol
threads.description: Wren and Ada row a skiff to the location of the Marisol, a ship that disappeared without a trace.

threads.name: Festival preparations
threads.description: Wren works at the chandlery in Greymouth during the preparations for the annual herring festival.

threads.name: Wren's investigation into her father
threads.description: Wren examines old ledgers and finds a note from her aunt, while Silas warns her about the dangers of uncovering the truth. | Wren meets Captain Abel Ferris, who reveals he is her father and hints at a curse related to the Devil's Cleft.

threads.name: Wren's investigation into the chandlery
threads.description: Wren investigates the chandlery and discovers a coded list of transactions under the floorboards.

threads.name: Wren's investigation into the Herring Festival
threads.description: Wren attends the Herring Festival and notices a pattern in seating arrangements, overhearing a conversation between Mr. Jameson and Mayor Thompson.

threads.name: Smuggling mystery
threads.description: Wren and Ada discover a hidden ledger in the old Anchor Inn, suggesting a deeper mystery related to smuggling.

threads.name: Smuggling history
threads.description: Mother Agathe recounts the history of smuggling in Greymouth, focusing on the Dunes and their leader Alaric, and his daughter Elara.

threads.name: Body on the beach
threads.description: Wren investigates a body that washed ashore during a storm, holding a dagger with dried blood.

threads.name: Tobin's secret
threads.description: Tobin hints at a dangerous situation involving money and people trying to keep things hidden. | Tobin admits to hiding something and promises not to go to the authorities.

threads.name: Wren's determination
threads.description: Wren decides to listen to Tobin and asks for the full story, showing her determination.

threads.name: Risk and safety
threads.description: Ada expresses concern about taking risks, and Wren defends continuing their dangerous work.

threads.name: Wren's investigation
threads.description: Wren sorts through her aunt's belongings in the attic and notices consistent payments to a local chapel. | Wren visits the chapel and meets with Reverend Thomas, gaining a deeper understanding of her aunt's character. | Wren and Ada decipher a Vigenère cipher in an attic, uncovering a record of charitable contributions.

threads.name: Mysterious meetings at the lighthouse
threads.description: Wren Halloway observes Silas Crane and Captain Elias Thorne meeting at the old lighthouse.

threads.name: Mysterious ledger
threads.description: Wren Halloway reveals the existence of a mysterious ledger from the old house attic.

threads.name: Investigation into the stranger's possessions
threads.description: Wren Halloway and Ada examine the possessions of a stranger found in the marsh.

threads.name: Tobin's guilt and evasion
threads.description: Wren confronts Tobin about the disappearances, but he denies involvement and runs away. | Wren rescues Tobin from drowning and leads him to a tavern.

threads.name: Uncovering the truth about the rope-works fire
threads.description: Wren visits the Anchor Inn and speaks with Thomas, an eyewitness to the rope-works fire. | Wren arrives at the Anchor Inn in Greymouth, overhearing accusations and revelations about the rope-works fire and the arrest of Samuel Blackwood.

threads.name: Thorne's investigation
threads.description: Wren visits Thorne's cottage to discuss the night the Marisol was lost, and they agree to investigate the captain's background.

threads.name: Wren's grief and reflection
threads.description: Wren reflects on Edric Thorne's death and his impact on the town.

threads.name: Liesel's suspicions
threads.description: Liesel brings bread to Wren and hints at rumors involving the new lighthouse and its keeper's sister.

threads.name: Investigation into salt trade irregularities
threads.description: Wren agrees to help with the investigation and is asked to bring the ledger to Crane the next morning.

threads.name: Mysterious man pursuing Wren's mother
threads.description: Wren receives letters from her mother's friend Eliza, which detail a mysterious man who pursued her mother and was involved in illegal activities.

threads.name: Safe house in Greymouth
threads.description: Eliza pleads for Wren to find a safe house in Greymouth.

threads.name: Thorne's funeral
threads.description: The town gathers for a solemn funeral, and a eulogy praises Thorne's legacy.

threads.name: Confrontation with Marcus Blackwood
threads.description: Wren and Ada confront Marcus Blackwood at the saltmarsh, leading to a tense encounter and a deal made by Ada. | A mysterious man in a black coat arrives and frees Wren and Ada from their trap, resolving the immediate confrontation.

threads.name: Investigation into the Devil's Cleft
threads.description: Wren learns about the Devil's Cleft and its dangers, expressing her readiness to investigate further.

threads.name: Wren's decision to reopen the chandlery
threads.description: Wren decides to reopen the chandlery after reading the last entry in the ledger.

threads.name: Cleaning and preparation of the chandlery
threads.description: Wren cleans the windows of the chandlery and sets up a schedule for restocking supplies and preparing for customers.
